manifest:
[package]
name = "rnx"
# 0.0.0 is not a placeholder: record 0026 keeps it there until record 0001's
# release gates pass, so a number never says more than the ladder has shown.
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
# The toolchain rnx is built and tested with, not a floor that has been found.
# 1.88 is measured to fail — in `rustyline`, on the unstable `file_lock` — and
# nothing between 1.89 and 1.94 has a toolchain here to try.
#
# Rune states its own minimum as 1.88 from 0.14.2 (`lib.rs`, raised from 1.87),
# which is a floor for one dependency and not for rnx: what has to compile is
# the whole set, and that is what fails at 1.88.
rust-version = "1.95"
description = "A scripting environment for Rune: a file runner, an expression evaluator, and an interactive session, on upstream Rune with no compiler fork."
repository = "https://github.com/nilket-com/rnx"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["rune", "scripting", "repl", "interpreter", "cli"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "development-tools"]
# What a user of the crate needs, and nothing else: the records are the
# project's reasoning rather than its product, and `journey.rn` needs a
# program from another repository to run at all.
exclude = ["plans/", "evidence.md", "journey.rn"]
# Two independent guards, and both stay until record 0001's decision 7 is
# settled: this says no, and the absent `license` field means crates.io would
# refuse it anyway.
publish = false

# Deliberately independent of the product workspace and its editor/GUI hosts.
[workspace]

[features]
default = ["count-allocations"]
# Allocation accounting. Without it no ceiling is enforced and no figure is
# reported; the build says so rather than reporting zero.
count-allocations = []
# Only for gates that must inject what cannot be provoked. Off by default, and
# nothing in an ordinary build reads it: record 0022 explains why the
# delivery's failure path needs one.
test-support = []

[dependencies]
rune = { version = "=0.14.2", default-features = false, features = ["std"] }
serde_json = "1.0.149"
jiff = { version = "=0.2.24", default-features = false, features = ["std", "tz-system", "tzdb-zoneinfo"] }
libc = "0.2.177"
rustyline = { version = "18.0.1", features = ["derive"] }
unicode-width = "0.2.2"
# The same identifier boundaries Rune uses, including combining marks.
unicode-ident = "1"
# Record 0034 adds networking to the current-thread execution runtime.
tokio = { version = "1", default-features = false, features = ["rt", "time", "net"] }
reqwest = { version = "=0.12.28", default-features = false, features = ["rustls-tls", "gzip"] }

[profile.dev]
debug = false

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 2

[dev-dependencies]
hyper = { version = "=1.11.1", default-features = false, features = ["server", "http1"] }
hyper-util = { version = "=0.1.20", default-features = false, features = ["tokio"] }
http-body-util = "=0.1.5"
bytes = "1"
tokio = { version = "1", default-features = false, features = ["rt", "time", "net", "sync", "macros"] }

flate2 = "1"
rustls = { version = "0.23", default-features = false, features = ["ring", "std", "tls12"] }
unicode-width = "0.2.2"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]
jiff = { version = "=0.2.24", default-features = false, features = ["std", "tz-system", "tzdb-zoneinfo", "tzdb-bundle-platform"] }
windows-sys = { version = "0.61.2", features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_System_JobObjects", "Win32_System_Threading", "Win32_System_Console", "Win32_System_Pipes", "Win32_System_IO", "Win32_System_Diagnostics_ToolHelp", "Win32_Storage_FileSystem", "Wdk_Storage_FileSystem"] }
